tools.name: sapo_get_store
tools.description: The Sapo store this login belongs to: name, domain, currency, timezone, plan and other settings. GET /admin/store.json.

tools.name: sapo_list_products
tools.description: List products with their variants, prices, SKUs and images. Filter by name, vendor, type, collection or created/modified dates. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /admin/products.json.

tools.name: sapo_count_products
tools.description: Number of products matching the filters. GET /admin/products/count.json.

tools.name: sapo_get_product
tools.description: One product by id, with variants and images. GET /admin/products/{id}.json.

tools.name: sapo_list_product_variants
tools.description: The variants (size, color, SKU, barcode, price) of one product. Paged. GET /admin/products/{product_id}/variants.json.

tools.name: sapo_get_product_variant
tools.description: One product variant by id. GET /admin/variants/{id}.json.

tools.name: sapo_list_custom_collections
tools.description: List manual product collections (danh mục thủ công). Paged. GET /admin/custom_collections.json.

tools.name: sapo_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with line items, customer, totals, payment and fulfillment status. Filter by status, tag, customer or dates. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /admin/orders.json.

tools.name: sapo_count_orders
tools.description: Number of orders matching the filters. GET /admin/orders/count.json.

tools.name: sapo_get_order
tools.description: One order by id with line items, addresses, discounts, payment and shipping. GET /admin/orders/{id}.json.

tools.name: sapo_list_order_transactions
tools.description: The payment transactions recorded on one order. GET /admin/orders/{order_id}/transactions.json.

tools.name: sapo_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with contact details, addresses, order count and total spent. Paged. GET /admin/customers.json.

tools.name: sapo_count_customers
tools.description: Total number of customers. GET /admin/customers/count.json.

tools.name: sapo_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id. GET /admin/customers/{id}.json.

tools.name: sapo_list_locations
tools.description: List branches, stores and warehouses (id, name, address, whether they track stock). Use the ids for stock levels. Paged. GET /admin/locations.json.

tools.name: sapo_list_inventory_items
tools.description: List inventory items (one per variant) by SKU/barcode search, variant or product ids. The id is what stock levels use as inventory_item_id. Paged. GET /admin/inventory_items.json.

tools.name: sapo_list_inventory_levels
tools.description: Stock per item and location: on_hand, available, committed, incoming, reserved. Filter by inventory item or location ids, or by a minimum/maximum available quantity. Sapo documents no paging for this list, so narrow it with ids. GET /admin/inventory_levels.json.

tools.name: sapo_list_price_rules
tools.description: List discount price rules (percentage, fixed amount, fixed price) with validity dates and usage counts. Paged. GET /admin/price_rules.json.

tools.name: sapo_update_order
tools.description: WRITE: set the note and/or the tags of an order (Sapo only lets an order's items and quantities stay fixed after creation). The value REPLACES the existing note or tags: read the order first to keep what is there. PUT /admin/orders/{id}.json.

tools.name: sapo_set_inventory_level
tools.description: WRITE: set the physical stock (on_hand) of one inventory item at one location to an exact quantity, with a reason. This OVERWRITES the current number and is recorded as a stock adjustment: read the level first (sapo_list_inventory_levels). PUT /admin/inventory_levels/set.json.
